name: Magic The Gathering
summary: A two-player dueling card game where wizards cast spells using mana to reduce the opponent to zero life.
rules_text: Each player has a shuffled library, a hand of seven cards, and 20 life. Players take sequential turns with draw, main, combat, and cleanup phases, untapping permanents at start. On your turn you may play one land to generate mana and cast spells by paying mana costs from your mana pool. Creatures, artifacts, enchantments and lands stay on the shared battlefield as permanents; instants and sorceries resolve then go to the graveyard. Players use the stack to respond to spells and abilities, resolving last-in first-out. You win by reducing opponent life to zero or if opponent must draw from an empty library. Mulligans allow reshuffling and drawing one fewer card.
rating_reason: Duel card game fits hidden hands and sequential choice
